text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan escapes to the beach with friends to avoid thinking about what comes next. She doesn't tell them, but she's skipping training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't mince words when I find her, declaring that she is well and truly a dummy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't mince words when I find her, declaring that she is well and truly a dummy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's precisely because she's a dummy that she can fly in the face of common sense and face every challenge head-on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And when she fights, she's cool. She inspires. Encouraged by my words and her friends, she turns once more to racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Embracing her stupidity, Jordan aims to be the greatest dummy. Her first step will be taking on Gold Ship in the Osaka Hai.
